records.subject: GI TAG FOR KAGGA RICE
records.extent:
The application for registration of GI (Geographical Indication) for Kagga Rice from
Uttara Kannada filed by M/s Visvesvarayya Trade Promotion Council, Department of
Industries and Commerce, Government of Karnataka, Bengaluru, in association with
the University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad, on 07.07.2023 is under examination
at GI Registry, Chennai
records.dep_name: PROMOTION OF INDUSTRY AND INTERNAL TRADE

records.subject: Installation of mobile towers
records.extent: It was inter-alia given in the Annexure that the number of new sites planned for installation of mobile towers in Dakshina Kannada in 2024-25 is 57 and the number of new sites in Udupi is 41.

records.subject: Tap water connections in Karnataka
records.extent:
remaining 15,474 villages are partially covered and works for providing 100% tap water
connection are at various stages.

records.subject: FINANCIAL AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT TO AGRI-STARTUPS
records.extent:
(a) to (d): It was inter-alia stated that the operational
guidelines for the Agriculture Accelerator Fund are in the process of consultation and
finalization.

records.subject: Development of Civil Aviation Sector
records.extent: (a) to (e) It was inter-alia stated that Ministry of Civil Aviation is in the process to assess the possibilities to frame guidelines on fractional ownership to promote small airlines/helicopter operations under NSOP category in consultations with Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Ministry of Finance, DGCA and Industry Stakeholders.
